convert_ncsnpp_checkpoint: convert an NCSN++ checkpoint state dict to a diffusers UNet2DModel state dict using the provided config
run_conversion_cli: run the CLI script to convert an NCSN++ checkpoint to a diffusers pretrained model using checkpoint and config paths
set_attention_weights: map NCSN++ attention layer weights including query, key, value, and projection matrices to a diffusers attention layer
set_resnet_weights: map NCSN++ ResNet block weights including convolutions, group norms, and time embeddings to a diffusers ResNet block
save_pretrained_pipeline: save a ScoreSdeVePipeline with the converted UNet model and scheduler to a specified output directory
